saw.source: PULSE_CMP half B (LM393BIDR pins 5/6/7), today tied off
saw.edge: SAW_LOGIC rises when SAW_RAW falls below the lower threshold, i.e. at the core reset; FF1 counts that edge

threshold.conditions: Ideal: +5V = 5.000 V, comparator VOL = 0 V, output leakage 0, resistors at nominal. Thresholds scale with the +5 V rail; LM393B offset (<=4.0 mV full temperature, fact-comparator-input-offset-voltage) and VOL (not retained) shift them.

netlist.pulse_cmp_half_b: unchanged tie-off: pin 5 AGND, pin 6 +5V, pin 7 NC

divider.ff1: D1 = NAND(Q1, SUB_DIV4_ON): toggles in -2, settles to Q1=1 otherwise; CLK1 = SUB_CLK; 1PRE and 1CLR tied to +5V
divider.ff2: D2 = 2Q-bar; CLK2 = NAND(SUB_CLK_GATE, Q1); 2PRE = SUB_PUL_OFF (holds Q2=1 in PUL); 2CLR tied to +5V
divider.power_up: No reset network. All four (Q1, Q2) states lie on the count cycle; Q1 reaches 1 within one reset in PUL and -1, Q2 is preset asynchronously in PUL. During the first ~0.4-1.1 ms both debounce nodes are low, which the table maps to PUL.
divider.sync: The divider is not reset by SYNC. It counts core resets, including hard-sync resets once the saw has passed the upper threshold; its phase relative to the sync master is one of 2 or 4 and stays fixed while sync persists.
divider.race_freedom: SUB_CLK_GATE is upstream of SUB_CLK in the Schmitt chain, so it is low before FF1 can change Q1; CLK2 = NAND(SUB_CLK_GATE, Q1) therefore has one rising edge per counted reset for any gate delays. Proven by the unit test over delay corners.

unused.rule: No unused-input rule is retained in the bundles; the project convention (envelope.finish_envelope, io_partition.spare) is used for the added Schmitt package: input AGND, output no-connect.

divider.bypass: 100 nF GRM188R71H104KA93D from pin 14 (+5V) to AGND per package, as for every IC rail

schmitt_sections.role: select A (PUL throw) debounced contact -> high when PUL
select B (-2 throw) debounced contact -> high when -2
clock chain stage 1: falls at the core reset
clock chain stage 2: rises at the core reset; clocks FF1
pulse squaring stage 2: same polarity as PULSE_LOGIC

gating.schmitt_packing: Seven sections: io_partition.refine fills the five spare sections of the existing SYNC SN74HC14DR and adds one package with 2 used and 4 grounded spare sections.
gating.output: SUB_OUT = NAND(NAND(PULSE_CLEAN, SUB_PUL_ON), Q2) -> R_SUB_ISO 4.7 kΩ -> SUB_SELECTED -> PUL_SCALE IN+
gating.select_conditioning: Each select line uses the switch_button_input topology (10 kΩ pull-up, 1 kΩ, 100 nF, Schmitt) but placed in the oscillator core on K; the contact lines cross the joint, the logic does not.

state_table.state: travel between PUL and -1 (break before make)
both lines low: shorted harness, or the first ~0.4-1.1 ms after +5 V rises while both debounce capacitors charge
joint unmated or toggle missing (pull-ups only)

proposed_input.low: SN74HC00 VOL at ~0 load via R_SUB_ISO 4.7 kΩ

level.argument: A CMOS output with no DC load stays between its own GND and VCC pins, here AGND and +5V, as the present open-collector-plus-pull-up node does. Both input sets therefore lie in [0, V(+5V)] and PUL_SCALED in [-V(LOCAL_REF5), 2 V(+5V) - V(LOCAL_REF5)], nominally -5 to +5 V, the audio_nominal_V range of the electrical standard. The low level moves towards -5 V by 2*(VOL_LM393 - VOL_HC00); exact VOL/VOH rows are an evidence need.
level.partial_power: With ±12 V absent and +5 V present, current into the unpowered PUL_SCALE input is limited by 4.7 kΩ to <= V(+5V)/4.7 kΩ = 1.064 mA, the same path the present PUL_PULL forms, against the retained 10 mA input-current absolute maximum (fact-op-audio-input-absolute).

debounce.conditions: Single-pole RC into the Schmitt input; HC14 threshold rows are retained at VCC 4.5 V (fact-schmitt-schmitt-high/low) and applied to a 5.0 V swing as an indicative bound. Contact bounce duration of the toggle is not retained.

octave_input.reference_effect: OSC_OCT0..5 lose the O2/O4 selector branches (owner decision DS-02) and gain nothing; no reference value, buffer or ladder element changes.

joint.pair: 1×3, one per SUB oscillator, P B.Cu to K F.Cu; connector not selected (ST-01)
joint.order_rule: signal-AGND-signal, as every P-to-K 1×3 pair; pin n of the P half mates pin n of the K half
joint.routing_note: Toggle pad 3 is at x-2.54, pad 2 at the centre, pad 1 at x+2.54 (rot 0); a pair with pin 1 at -x reaches each throw without a crossing. A mirrored mate would swap PUL and -2 only; netlist parity catches it.
joint.near_site_parts: None added on P besides the toggle and the pair half. All K-side conditioning may sit anywhere in the OSC2/OSC4 core; nothing is required within the 0.7 mm window.

implementation_notes_for_ST11: Split the shared oscillator family into a SUB variant for O2 and O4; O4 is also split by precision-tssop-retention.json, so the SUB variant must compose with that split.
Builder.finish() maps SN74HC74DR and SN74HC00DR to the ±12 V bypass branch; add them to the +5 V branch, or io_partition.refine() raises "orphaned bypass capacitors".
Create the select conditioning with oscillator roles, not b.cell("switch_button_input"): that role is a CONTROL_CELL and would move the parts to P.
Use the exact contact lines (RC0603FR-0710KL, RC0603FR-071KL) via CATALOG, as the cells do; b.r() would assign the RT0603BRD series with no MPN.
Append new parts after existing ones so the designator lock only grows.
